opening: Entirely fictional evaluation. Entirely fictional case LIVE-MULTI-57: a 57-year-old man weighing 70 kg developed a rash on 03 September 2026. He took warfarin 5 mg by mouth daily from 01 August 2026 for atrial fibrillation and acetaminophen 650 mg by mouth every six hours from 01 September 2026 for pain. Warfarin is suspect; acetaminophen is concomitant. Warfarin was stopped on 04 September 2026, the rash improved after stopping, and warfarin was never restarted. Acetaminophen was not stopped or reduced. He was hospitalized; no other serious outcomes apply. INR was 4.8 on 03 September 2026 with reference limits 0.8 and 1.2; ALT was 67 U/L on 03 September 2026 with reference limits 7 and 56. The INR collection time was not recorded. No additional relevant history applies. This is an adverse-event report, and the product is not available for evaluation. These two products are explicitly medications.
